sfx.name: Ambient Void
sfx.description: Near silence, distant city hum, subtle tension
source_terms: room tone subtle hum cinematic tension
sfx.notes: Make the viewer wonder if their audio is working. No melody, no rhythm.

sfx.name: Rain on Window
sfx.description: Soft rain hitting glass, distant thunder rumble
sfx.visual: Ocean sunset, ocean cliff waves, beach sand, rain on glass window
source_terms: rain window glass soft distant thunder
sfx.notes: Layer with ocean waves at lower volume. Rain should feel intimate, not stormy.

sfx.name: Ocean Waves Distant
sfx.description: Distant ocean waves, low and rolling
sfx.visual: Ocean sunset, ocean cliff waves, beach sand
processing: low-pass at 5kHz to push it back
sfx.notes: Support layer. Should feel like it's outside the window, not in the room.

sfx.name: Construction Site Ambience
sfx.description: Distant construction hum, crane machinery, industrial low-end
sfx.visual: Construction crane at dusk, building under construction
source_terms: construction site distant hum crane machinery
sfx.notes: This replaces the original pencil/paper plan. The approved footage is construction, so the sound must match. Keep it distant and restrained.

sfx.name: Soft Room Tone
sfx.description: Very quiet interior, almost imperceptible air movement
sfx.scene: Every dream begins the same way.
source_terms: room tone quiet interior air movement
sfx.notes: This is the quietest moment. The SFX should almost disappear.

sfx.name: Rain on Street
sfx.description: Wet street ambience, puddle reflections, distant city
sfx.visual: Empty office, abandoned factory, rain on street
source_terms: rain street wet puddle city distant
sfx.notes: Slightly sadder than Scene 2 rain. More distant, more urban.

sfx.name: Abandoned Factory Hum
sfx.description: Low industrial drone, decay, distant metal creak
source_terms: abandoned factory hum industrial drone decay
sfx.notes: Dark and empty. Should feel like the building itself is breathing its last.

sfx.name: Waterfall Crescendo
sfx.visual: Palm trees paradise, forest sunlight, waterfall, rainforest
sfx.notes: This should build energy into the first music swell. Loudest nature moment.

sfx.name: Rocket Engine Rumble
sfx.description: Distant rocket engine rumble, launch pad power
sfx.visual: Rocket taking off, runway, dawn light
source_terms: rocket engine distant rumble launch pad
sfx.notes: Only for the rocket-launch clip. Cut when the clip cuts.

sfx.name: Robot Arm Servo
sfx.description: Industrial robot arm mechanical movement, hydraulic precision
sfx.visual: Robot arm in high-tech factory, industrial automation
processing: high-pass at 200Hz to remove low mud
sfx.placement: Follow visual motion (L to R or R to L)
sfx.notes: Tight and precise. Not whiny — industrial and confident.

sfx.name: Server Rack Hum
sfx.description: Data center electrical hum, cooling fans, low buzz
sfx.visual: Server racks, cable management, blinking lights
source_terms: server rack hum data center electrical buzz
sfx.notes: Steady and hypnotic. Should feel like the brain of the operation.

sfx.name: Keyboard Clicks
sfx.description: Rapid but subtle typing, dark room developer foley
sfx.visual: Computer screen glow on face in dark room, man working at computer
source_terms: keyboard typing rapid subtle office mechanical
sfx.placement: Slightly left or right depending on screen position
sfx.notes: Very subtle. Should register as 'someone is working' not 'keyboard solo'.

sfx.name: Laboratory Glass Clink
sfx.description: Scientist moving equipment, microscope adjustment, glass on metal
sfx.visual: Scientist looking into microscope, scientists in laboratory
sfx.notes: One or two precise movements. Don't overdo it.

sfx.name: Neural Pulse
sfx.description: Electrical synapse sound, digital data stream, soft electrical hum
sfx.visual: Neural network visualization, brain glow art, neural connections
processing: light chorus or shimmer for ethereal feel
source_terms: neural synapse electrical pulse digital data stream
sfx.notes: Ethereal and intelligent. Should feel like thought becoming real.

sfx.name: Microscope Focus
sfx.description: Microscope dial turn, precision equipment, soft metal click
sfx.visual: Female scientist looking into microscope, person using microscope
sfx.notes: Single focus turn. Precise and clean.

sfx.name: Welding Sparks
sfx.description: Distant welding, spark crackle, metal construction
sfx.visual: Peak montage — fastest cuts, hero shots, welding steel
source_terms: welding sparks distant metal construction crackle
sfx.notes: Last SFX before the hard cut. Should feel explosive but still sit under the music peak. Cut dead at 0:42. No tail.
